name: Title commitment
what: The title insurer's offer to issue a policy, listing what it will insure, what must happen first and what it will not cover.

fields.label: Effective date
fields.definition: The date through which the public records were searched.

fields.label: Commitment ends
fields.definition: The date the commitment lapses unless the policy issues first; on the Texas form, 90 days after the effective date.

fields.label: Proposed insured
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule A, item 1

fields.label: Policy amount
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule A, item 1

fields.label: Interest covered
fields.definition: The estate in the land the commitment covers, such as fee simple or a leasehold.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule A, item 2

fields.label: Title vested in
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule A, item 3

fields.label: Legal description
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule A, item 4

fields.label: Exceptions
fields.definition: Matters the policy will not cover, such as recorded easements, restrictions, the area-and-boundary exception and current taxes.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.definition: What must be done or delivered before the policy issues, such as releases, payoffs and evidence that recent work is paid; anything not cleared becomes an exception.

fields.label: Estimated premium
fields.definition: The estimated premium for the policy and endorsements; in Texas, set by the promulgated rate chart.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule D; Tex. Ins. Code 2703.151
